faqs.question: How do I know if I have carpenter ants in my Flatlands home?
faqs.answer: Look for large black or dark brown ants (especially in spring), piles of sawdust-like material near wooden areas, faint rustling sounds in walls, and small holes in wood. Flatlands homes with mature trees or moisture issues are particularly susceptible. Call for a free phone consultation to discuss carpenter ant activity confirmation.
